name: Out of Sight, Out of Mind
definition: Absence diminishes minor passions and inflames great ones. Those in power who remove themselves from daily contact increase their perceived importance and mystique.
detection_signal: A powerful character deliberately makes themselves scarce or unavailable, causing others to fixate on them more intensely.
counter_considerations: Do not flag when the absence is involuntary or when the character is genuinely trying to step away from power rather than weaponize absence.

name: Conceal Your Intentions
definition: Keep people off balance and in the dark by never revealing the purpose behind your actions. If they have no clue what you are up to, they cannot prepare a defense.
detection_signal: A character acts with hidden purpose, giving vague or misleading explanations for their behavior while pursuing a secret agenda.
counter_considerations: Do not flag when the character's secrecy is self-protective rather than manipulative or when the hidden intent is eventually revealed to the audience.

name: Be Bold, Be Bold
definition: Boldness and audacity can overwhelm hesitation and create an impression of confidence that bends others to your will. Daring action shocks opponents into submission.
detection_signal: A character takes a dramatic, risky action that shocks others into compliance or admiration, exploiting the assumption that someone that bold must have the goods to back it up.
counter_considerations: Do not flag when the boldness is reckless rather than strategic or when the character lacks the competence to support their audacious claims.

name: Selective Honesty and Generosity
definition: The occasional display of honesty or generosity disarms the target, creating a gift that makes them lower their guard and forget the larger manipulative pattern.
detection_signal: A character performs a seemingly genuine kind act or tells a small truth that serves to build trust before a larger betrayal or manipulation.
counter_considerations: Do not flag when the honesty or generosity is sincere and not part of a larger strategic pattern.

name: Play to People's Fantasies
definition: The truth is often ugly or unpleasant. Appeal to powerful fantasy rather than harsh reality. People who feel deprived will believe anything that promises relief.
detection_signal: A character sells a vision, lifestyle, or outcome that appeals to deep desires rather than offering concrete evidence or realistic plans.
counter_considerations: Do not flag when the fantasy is aspirational and backed by real effort or when the character genuinely believes in what they are promising.

name: Guard Your Reputation
definition: Reputation is the cornerstone of power. A damaged reputation is nearly impossible to repair. Protect it ferociously and attack the reputation of your enemies ruthlessly.
detection_signal: A character goes to extreme lengths to control how others perceive them, or destroys someone's reputation as a strategic move.
counter_considerations: Do not flag when reputation management is genuinely warranted to correct falsehoods or when the character's concern with reputation is parodic.

name: Crush Sentimentality
definition: Sentimentality is a weakness that clouds judgment and opens you to manipulation. Those in power must make decisions based on strategic reality, not emotional attachment.
detection_signal: A character chooses a cold, pragmatic path over an emotionally satisfying one, or a character is exploited because of their emotional attachments.
counter_considerations: Do not flag when the narrative treats emotional connection as a strength or when the 'cold' choice is actually the wrong one.
